title: RevZilla Maintenance Order Lead Time
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=revzilla:order order_type=maintenance
| eval ship_lag_days=round((delivered_epoch-ordered_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(ship_lag_days) as avg_ship_lag_days, max(ship_lag_days) as worst_ship_lag_days by vendor_category
| sort - worst_ship_lag_days
description: Measures how long maintenance-related parts orders take to arrive from the moment they are placed.
value: Lead-time visibility helps you order consumables before a ride weekend turns into a garage wait.
implementation: Export RevZilla order history with ordered and delivered timestamps and tag maintenance-related items consistently.
visualization: Table of maintenance part categories by average and worst shipping lag.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how long it takes for the maintenance bits you ordered to actually show up.
